format: custom implementation specification, not auto-loaded config
real_time_rule: Start 300-second monotonic server deadline at first meteor. Tick count alone is insufficient under lag. Persist wall-clock expiry for restart recovery.
event_center: snapshot of impact-zone ground position chosen when activation finishes
red_sky: local to event area; blend by distance and smooth day/night transition. Preserve normal world time.
meteor_trail: full-bright billboard ribbon oriented opposite velocity, not fixed world-axis particles
world_changes: Crater, explosion, ignition and damage are server-authoritative; do not infer them from client particles.
performance: Distant meteors are cosmetic client trails. No ticking unseen chunks; ground impacts only in loaded chunks. Rate, radius and budgets configurable.
end_rule: Stop new meteors at deadline; existing meteors finish within a short bounded grace period. Fade local red sky, detach camera effects; already placed fires follow vanilla rules.
celestial_end_rule: Persist destroyed-body state separately from temporary red sky. Do not spontaneously restore the broken sun/moon just because rain ended.
cancel_cleanup: Clear client overlays, tracked meteors, camera effects on cancellation; server owns event state.
